senses.gloss: śokāgāra (m. or nt.), grief-house, hall of lamentation (rendered boudoir [orig. sulking room, but its present-day mg. is not appropriate] by Feer on Av and by Divy Index, followed by pw 〔7.378〕): ˚raṃ praviśya kare kapolaṃ dattvā (once kṛtvā) cintāparo vyavasthitaḥ Av 〔i.55.4〕; 〔375.11〕; 〔ii.37.3〕; 〔53.11〕; 〔97.4〕; ˚raṃ praviśyāvasthitaḥ Divy 〔287.13〕, cf. 〔288.2—3〕 kasmāt tvaṃ … kare kapolaṃ dattvā cintāparas tiṣṭhasi; for the cause of his grief see 〔287.8 ff.〕; MSV 〔i.64.17〕.
